owner: PAIX Data Centres and Djibouti Sovereign Fund
notes: PAIX announced a joint venture with the Djibouti Sovereign Fund to construct a 50,000 sq ft cloud- and carrier-neutral data center in Djibouti City. DCD reports JIB1 is planned for 5 MW IT capacity and scheduled to open in 2026; Mobile Europe describes up to 5 MW of critical power with first phase expected in 2026.
